description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class named CustomerController for managing customer data in a banking application. It provides endpoints for CRUD operations such as retrieving all customers, adding a customer, retrieving, updating, and deleting a customer by customer number.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller for customer management operations, exposing endpoints for CRUD functionalities using Spring Web annotations.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all customer details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new customer, accepting customer details in the request body.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update customer details identified by customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by customer number.
